title: Honoring Guild Member Vivien Oswell (100 years young) at the July 8, 2023 art reception at 820 Main Street Gallery in Harwich Port.
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder July 10, 2023

Date/Time
Date(s) - 07/10/2023 - 08/31/2023
11:00 am - 3:00 pm

Categories No Categories


Guild of Harwich Artists members showed up to honor Vivien at the July 8th art show reception at 820 Main Street, Harwich Port, hosted by gallery owner Sue Lilly. Georgia Dearborn and Vivien Oswell, co-founders of the Guild of Harwich Artists, began selling their paintings in the mid-1970’s in Doane Park in Harwich Port. There were soon joined by other local artists. In 1979, they established the Guild which 43 years later still shows their artworks in Doane Park on Mondays from July to late September.

In 2007, twenty-two Guild members established the Guild’s Art Gallery at 551 Main Street  The Art Gallery is open everyday from 11am to 4pm, from July to September, and weekends till mid-December.

Bookings

Bookings are closed for this event.
